name: order-intake-o2c-exception
description: Retail Wave 2 Cowork plugin (heavy CPG usage): orders arriving by email, PDF and portal validated and exceptions routed instead of rekeyed. Extracts and normalises order lines; validates against customer, pricing, product and credit master data (order_validate); queues exceptions with reason codes and a recommended correction per exception (exception_route); drafts the customer response. Ships at action level L0-L2: order creation and release stay human-approved until the customer promotes the action level in config/.
